about: Where each checked script goes in Descript, and what Krish allowed. Read by scripts/post-pack/descript_send.py and making.py descript; a send or a record refuses unless status is confirmed and the drive is this one. One view-access project per piece and cut, in folder_root/<pack folder>, with two compositions: Script (the pages video he reads on his phone) and Record here (a 1-second slate where he records, on a laptop or the Descript web app). Nothing in Descript is ever published, edited or deleted by the send, and no AI credits are spent.
